name: MSI
description: Industrial information processing in safety-critical domains requires the integration of heterogeneous data sources and the transformation of domain expertise into actionable knowledge. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a data processing framework for industrial large language models (LLMs) that standardizes multisource data integration, semantic cleaning, and quality monitoring for large-scale model training. Based on this framework, we construct Mine Safety Intelligence(MSI), a multisource and multitask corpus containing 10 GB of domain text and 10,000 high-quality instruction–response pairs covering safety regulations, emergency response, and risk management. Using this data set, we develop MS-GLM, a domain-adaptive LLM for coal mining safety applications. To ensure reliable evaluation, we establish a dedicated benchmark (CMS-QED) and an expert-driven scoring framework (CMS-QEM) that jointly assess accuracy, interpretability, and user experience.
